resources.string: Diagnosis is read-only. Opening this dialog or refreshing does not start a repair. Boot properties are reported values, not proof of hardware attestation.
Reading engine, keybox and vendor tool status…
Reported boot state: %1$s\nFlash locked: %2$s · Device state: %3$s

OMY software restoration fetches a keybox, restores and starts the bundled software engine, gives it priority over external copies, and requests automatic startup. It does not rewrite the vendor TEE or restore hardware trust. Startup after reboot depends on daemon support. This can take several minutes.
Software restoration steps passed. Review the refreshed diagnosis. Vendor TEE was not rewritten.
Software restoration returned steps that need attention. Review each result below. Vendor TEE was not rewritten.

Vendor TEE writeback is a separate operation. It uses the existing KmInstallKeybox API and the current keybox. The API rechecks root, tool ownership and permissions, keybox presence and DeviceID before invoking the vendor tool.
No checked vendor tool is available. Vendor writeback is unavailable.
Vendor tool checks did not pass.
Vendor writeback requires a current keybox.

Write the current keybox into the vendor TEE? This changes secure hardware provisioning and may fail on this device. The API attempts a backup of the keybox file; that is not a backup of TEE state. A successful tool exit does not prove hardware attestation is restored.
Write current keybox to vendor TEE
Vendor tool reported success. Hardware attestation has not been independently verified.\n%1$s
